jobs.title: Infrastructure Architect
jobs.description: Employer career level: Mid-level Professional. Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software. We are seeking a seasoned Senior Infrastructure Architect to lead, scale, and modernize our global Infrastructure operations. In this pivotal leadership role, you will own the end-to-end architecture, reliability, performance, and security of our multi-cloud SaaS platforms (AWS & Azure) supporting enterprise-grade customer workloads across multiple geographies. Beyond core cloud architecture and operational leadership, the ideal candidate brings deep domain expertise in Siemens enterprise products—specifically Teamcenter—enabling us to architect robust, high-performance environments tailored for complex PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) workloads. You will act as the operational and architectural anchor, guiding a distributed team of engineers across India, Malaysia, Mexico, Poland, and Egypt. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Infrastructure Leadership & Operations Management Operational Ownership: Assume full leadership responsibility for all global infrastructure operations, setting operational excellence standards, SLAs, and KPIs for availability, latency, and disaster recovery. Team Leadership & Mentoring: Lead, inspire, and grow distributed InfraOps and platform engineering teams spanning multiple time zones (India, Malaysia, Mexico, Poland, Egypt). Foster a culture of automation, reliability, and continuous improvement. Multi-Cloud Architecture (AWS & Azure): Design, deploy, and maintain scalable, secure, and cost-effective cloud architectures. Drive the migration, optimization, and modernization of legacy infrastructure to modern cloud-native standards. 2. Siemens Teamcenter & Enterprise PLM Infrastructure Expertise PLM Infrastructure Mastery: Architect, deploy, and manage high-availability environments specifically optimized for Siemens Teamcenter and associated enterprise engineering software stacks. Performance & Scalability: Ensure optimal database performance, CAD data streaming/visualization efficiency (e.g., Visualization/VisMockup architectures), secure file management (FMS/FSC), and seamless multi-site deployments for global users. Integration & Lifecycle: Collaborate closely with AppOps, Solution Consultants, and FinOps teams to ensure Teamcenter environments integrate cleanly with CI/CD pipelines, identity providers, and monitoring frameworks. 3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & FinOps Alignment Consultative Partnership: Partner with customer-facing Solution Consultants and regional teams to transition technical delivery from "order-taking" to proactive cloud and platform consulting. Cost Optimization (FinOps): Work alongside FinOps to continuously audit, right-size, and optimize cloud infrastructure spending without compromising performance or uptime. Security & Compliance: Ensure all infrastructure operations adhere to stringent enterprise security baselines, compliance frameworks, and disaster recovery protocols. Key Requirements Experience: 12+ years in IT infrastructure engineering, cloud architecture, and operations leadership, with at least 5+ years in a senior architect or director-level role managing global teams. Siemens Domain Expertise: Deep hands-on or architectural experience with Siemens Teamcenter (Deployment, Enterprise Architecture, 4-tier environments, FMS, Active Workspace) is a strong core requirement and significant differentiator. Cloud Mastery: Extensive, production-level experience architecting and operating enterprise SaaS platforms on AWS and Azure. Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or Azure Solutions Architect Expert strongly preferred. Global Operations Experience: Proven track record of managing and developing technical operations teams across multiple regions and cultures (APAC, EMEA, LATAM). Modern Tooling & Automation: Strong advocacy for Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible), CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and observability stacks (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana). Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. What We Offer High Impact: Direct ownership of the infrastructure backbone powering mission-critical global SaaS operations. Global Collaboration: Work with a diverse, highly talented, and distributed team across 5 countries. Autonomy & Innovation: Empowered to modernize tech stacks, introduce cutting-edge automation, and shape the future of our enterprise cloud operations. . Why us? Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we Work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Siemens Software. Our software enables customers to manage the full lifecycle of assets, facilities, and infrastructure while improving efficiency, reducing risk, and optimizing long-term investments. You’ll operate at the intersection of design craft and strategic influence, shaping product direction, setting team quality standards, and building design capability across the organization. You’ll own the most complex design problems, represent design in stakeholder conversations, and be a formative influence on Siemens’ AI-powered product experiences. jobs.title: Head of Financial Controller
jobs.description: About Bosta: Launched in 2017, Bosta is an overnight delivery provider for E-commerce companies in Egypt. Leveraging technology to empower businesses is what we do best. Our goal is to disrupt the logistics industry by bringing technology and experience all together to provide a one-stop-shop for delivery solutions. We rely on advanced technology to deliver orders to our customers in a fast way. Businesses can track and connect with couriers and follow up on their orders - all in one system. Financial Accounting & Reporting Oversee the general ledger and lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, delivering accurate and timely financial statements in line with Egyptian Accounting Standards / IFRS. Responsible for all group and consolidated financial statements, including intercompany eliminations and reporting across all group entities. Review and approve journal entries, reconciliations, and balance sheet substantiation; own the chart of accounts and accounting policies. Revenue & COD Accounting Oversee revenue recognition for shipping and related services, ensuring completeness of billing and control over discounts, refunds, and revenue leakage. Supervise the full COD cycle: daily collections, courier and hub cash reconciliations, and accurate merchant payout liabilities. Treasury, Banking & Payment Authorization Act as an authorized bank signatory: review and authorize bank transfers for customer COD payouts and AP payments within the approved delegation-of-authority matrix. Ensure every payment released is fully documented, reconciled, and approved through the proper workflow, with strict segregation of duties across payment initiation, review, and release. Oversee cash positioning, bank reconciliations, cash-flow forecasting, and bank relationships and mandates. Accounts Payable & Procurement Oversee the end-to-end AP cycle (invoice processing, three-way matching, vendor reconciliations) and approve payment runs within authority limits. Oversee procurement, ensuring purchasing complies with policy, budgets, and approval matrices, with proper vendor selection and documentation. Oversee vendor sourcing, negotiation, and contract terms to achieve cost savings while maintaining quality and service levels. Monitor purchase order controls, vendor performance, and the handoff between procurement, receiving, and AP to ensure a clean procure-to-pay cycle. Inventory & Fixed Assets Oversee inventory accounting and controls, including physical counts and provisioning, and maintain a complete and accurate fixed asset register. Tax & Compliance Ensure timely, accurate filing of all tax obligations (VAT, withholding, payroll, corporate income tax, and e-invoicing) and lead external audits and tax inspections to clean outcomes. Internal Controls & Audit Implement and monitor a robust internal control framework over the COD, procure-to-pay, and record-to-report cycles, with a strong focus on fraud and cash-handling risks. Leadership & Process Improvement Lead, coach, and develop seven functional managers and a team of approximately 40 accountants, setting objectives, KPIs, and succession plans. Drive automation and ERP optimization, including COD reconciliation tooling and integrations between operational and financial systems.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: ABOUT THE ROLE Alpha isn’t a chatbot sitting on top of a product. It’s an agent that reads a customer’s account, reasons about their plan, and prepares real orders for them to confirm. The model is the easy part. The hard part is everything around it: the tools it calls, the context it sees, how a request gets routed, the guardrails that keep it away from anything that must be exact, and the deterministic systems underneath that place orders, move money and consume events. You’ll own parts of that system end to end, from spec to production. When something goes wrong in a conversation, you’ll be the one who opens the traces and finds where the run went wrong. You’ll decide whether the fix belongs in a tool, a prompt, the routing, the backend or the model, and prove it with an eval. Then you’ll explain it so product, design and other squads can act on it. Much of the work crosses squads. Alpha integrates with Thndr’s order, funding, savings and market-data services, so you’ll write proposals other teams adopt as well as code. We also work with served models beyond Alpha, so some of the work goes below the API: choosing, evaluating, fine-tuning and serving models for other Thndr products. We work through coding agents every day. We expect you to be very good at running your own and at helping others fix their workflows. This is an R&D role, and we hire for breadth on purpose. Most of your time goes to Alpha, but the same person who fixes a routing failure on Monday might be benchmarking an open model, prototyping an agent for another squad, or testing whether a new technique is worth adopting by Friday. We expect you to pick up unfamiliar problems quickly, take them from research to something running in production, and know when an experiment should stop. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Own parts of Alpha end to end. Take a module, such as a tool family, the evaluation pipeline or an integration, and be accountable for how it behaves, its quality in production, and its long-term health. Don’t just follow the design we have: change it when it’s wrong. • Design the harness. Tool contracts that read as the model’s instructions, context the model can use, routing between capabilities, and guardrails that move must-have rules out of prompt text and into code. Start from the behaviour a customer needs and work back to the component. • Build observability and evaluation that people trust. Read traces before building dashboards. Categorise real failures and fix the most upstream one first. Build evals that check the resulting state, not just the final message. Validate LLM judges against human labels. Know the noise floor before calling something a win or a regression. • Run Alpha like a production service. Own latency, reliability and cost for your area: time to first token, end-to-end turn latency, streaming, provider rate limits and fallbacks, and cost per conversation. Set the budgets, monitor them, and get paged when they break. • Engineer the deterministic parts properly. Retrieval, event consumers that drive automated execution, planning and allocation logic, and integrations with money-moving services, with idempotency, retries and reconciliation. Keep the LLM away from anything that has to be exact. • Work below the API when it pays off. Evaluate, fine-tune and serve transformer models for Alpha and other Thndr products. Run the model lifecycle like software: versioned data and evals, reproducible training, safe rollout and rollback. • Turn questions into decisions. Take a vague “is this working?” and answer it with data: SQL over production traces, experiment design, and choosing between prompting, routing, fine-tuning or a different model. Then communicate the answer so non-specialists act on it. • Lead cross-squad proposals. Write designs that other squads adopt for integrating Alpha with their systems, and take them from proposal to shipped. • Raise the team’s bar. Review other engineers’ designs and evals, and help teammates improve how they work with coding agents: instructions, verification, review discipline. • Take R&D beyond Alpha. Prototype and evaluate AI solutions for other Thndr products and squads, research new models and techniques, and turn the ones that earn it into production systems. jobs.title: Senior Application Engineer II
jobs.description: Who are we and what we stand for? Schneider Electric's purpose is to create Impact by empowering all to make the most of our energy and resources, bridging progress and sustainability for all. We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Application Engineer to join our Centre of Excellence (CoE) and lead the design, validation, and execution of advanced industrial automation solutions across the MEA Zone, with EcoStruxure Automation Expert (EAE) at the core. This position will act as a technical leader for customers, partners, sales teams, Solution Architects, and Global Delivery teams across the complete application lifecycle, from technical discovery and architecture definition through project execution, commissioning support, troubleshooting, and optimization. The role requires broad multi-vendor automation expertise across Schneider Electric, Siemens, and Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley PLC platforms, together with experience in AVEVA and other SCADA/HMI systems. The Senior Application Engineer will lead complex migrations, integration strategies, technical governance, and the development of reusable engineering standards while mentoring junior engineers and partners. What will you do? Cooperate with Sales and Solution Architects with technical strategy, application architecture, competitive differentiation, demonstrations, and solution validation to win complex automation opportunities using EAE. Lead technical discovery with customers, OEMs, System Integrators, and end users; translate machine, process, plant, and business requirements into scalable control, HMI/SCADA, networking, safety-aware, and IT/OT architectures. Own the technical execution of indirect projects with Schneider Electric partners and coordinate direct projects with Global Delivery teams across the MEA Zone, including scope, design reviews, risk management, validation, escalation, and technical acceptance. Design, review, and optimize multi-vendor automation architectures involving Schneider Electric Modicon platforms and EAE, and migration from Siemens SIMATIC/TIA Portal, and Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 platforms. Lead SCADA/HMI architecture, integration, and migration activities using AVEVA System Platform, AVEVA Plant SCADA, AVEVA Edge, EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert, and comparable third-party SCADA platforms where required. Lead competitor migration assessments from Siemens, Allen-Bradley, and other legacy PLC/SCADA platforms to Schneider Electric and EAE, including code analysis, I/O and communication mapping, functional conversion, testing, and risk mitigation. Conduct design audits, application assessments, Factory Acceptance Tests, performance validation, and troubleshooting for mission-critical or large-scale automation projects. Define and govern engineering standards, reusable libraries, CATs, templates, APIs, simulation/test methods, and documentation that reduce engineering effort and improve quality, scalability, and lifecycle maintainability. Lead customer workshops, roadmap discussions, POCs, demos, and technical presentations; clearly communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and business value to technical and management stakeholders. Mentor junior engineers and partners, review technical deliverables, and collaborate with the Global Teams and Lines of Business (LoB) to resolve complex application gaps and scale proven solutions. What are the key skills we are looking for? Industrial Automation Architecture & Technical Leadership - advanced level; leading the design and delivery of complex machine, process, and plant automation solutions, including control architecture, sequence design, system integration, validation, commissioning, and lifecycle support. Multi-Vendor PLC Engineering - advanced level; hands-on expertise with Schneider Electric Modicon PLCs and EAE, plus strong experience with Siemens SIMATIC/TIA Portal and Rockwell Automation/Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 for design, troubleshooting, integration, and migration. SCADA, HMI & Supervisory Systems - advanced level; designing and integrating AVEVA System Platform, AVEVA Plant SCADA, AVEVA Edge, EcoStruxure Operator Terminal Expert, and comparable SCADA/HMI platforms, including alarms, trends, historian interfaces, redundancy, and high availability. Keep track of any discrepancies in expenditure with respect to the budget in the monthly report and explain them. Keep the NCR monitoring and opportunity & claim folder up to date. Manage the risks inherent in the site (identify them and find all the solutions required to eradicate or avoid them). Prepare the project, before work starts on the site, in conjunction with the various departments, the GCP /Ops Operation department and Site Works Coordinator, the Project Manager: Design review, contract kick off meetings, site staff mobilisation, etc. Prepare the budget quote for the internal contract in conjunction with the site works coordinator. Define the assembly methodologies with the site works coordinator and how they can be adapted to the contractual requirements of the project. Pass this work plan on to the project Site supervisors. Set up the organizational structure and the offices on the site. Comply with the site organizational requirements as defined with the Project Manager and the GCP /Ops Operation department. Manage the project in conjunction with the Site supervisor(s) (in accordance with the job specifications, the contractual terms, the Assignment order, the Quality plan, the HSE plan and the operating procedures). Accept and store the equipment and devices on site. Ensure that the site organization and the work execution procedures, tests and commissioning and all the resources used on the site(s) (buildings, containers, machines, vehicles) comply with the current legislation and the local regulations. With respect to HSE issues, He/She relies on the HSE manager on each site. Provide the Site Works Coordinator with technical support, if required. Set up a site quality plan Take all the measures required to control the products supplied by the customer and incorporated in the works and operate or ensure the operation and quality of the site(s) in accordance with the project operating procedures, folders and instructions received in order to comply with the Quality Management System. (NCR monitoring, etc.) Understand and qualify the customer's facilities in order to propose improvement works or solutions. Ensure that the monitoring, test and commissioning equipment and devices are maintained, routinely checked, calibrated, transported and delivered to the site. Ensure, in conjunction with the site and test supervisor(s), that all the operators, including the subcontractors, have updated their drawings and that when the site is finished, the site "RED MARKS" documents are sent to the Design Office to enable the final "AS BUILT" documents to be completed. Interface with the Project Manager and reporting In conjunction with the Site Works Coordinator, draw up the following documents and send them to the Project Manager and the GCP /Ops Operation department: monthly status report with discrepancy monitoring, monthly progress report, minutes of meetings, statement of damage occurring during transportation and on site, state of the equipment on arrival on site, condition of the final stocks, operating incident records, equipment incident records, non-conformance records, etc. At the end of the project, in conjunction with the Site Works Coordinator, prepare all the items required for the end-of-project assessment and feedback with the organization responsible for the contract and ensure that the annotated documents and drawings (assembly, tests, etc.) are centralized at the end of the project in order to check that they are valid before sending them to the Project Manager and to the customer, after approval by the Project Manager. Compliance with HSE requirements. Ensure that Health and safety requirements are applied at site (Local regulatons, SE directives, customer requirements). Ensure that the resources to be allocated on site, the skills, experience, accreditation level according to the nature of the work to be done are adapted. Implement, manage and update site safety plan and risk assessment related. Make sure that FSRs and Sub contractors under his/her/her responsibilty apply HSE rules. Perform site safety inspections. Conduct periodic safety meetings and manage action plans. Manage safety incidents and take immediate actions. Monitor, document, track and review safety KPI. According to the skills, means and authority, the site manager has overall responsibility for the EHS aspects on sites for which he/she is responsible. What's in it for me? Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering 5 to 8 years of experience. Confirmed experience or literacy with any of Schneider Equipment for MV (Premset, MCSET, PIX), Protection Relays (SEPAM, Micom, Easergy), UPS APC Symmetra and LV Distribution panels (Blokset, Okken, Prisma) is advantage. jobs.title: SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning Consultant
jobs.description: Job Description: SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning Consultant Role Overview DXC Technology is seeking an experienced SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Planning Consultant to join a large-scale SAP S/4HANA implementation and rollout programme. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and implementing SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions, enabling integrated budgeting, forecasting, and operational planning processes based on SAP S/4HANA data. The role will focus on delivering scalable, driver-based planning models, establishing structured planning workflows, and ensuring accurate reconciliation between financial actuals, budgets, and forecasts. The candidate will work closely with Finance, Controlling, and other functional and technical teams to deliver effective planning solutions. Key Responsibilities Participate in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning design workshops with Finance and Operations stakeholders to define planning requirements, models, drivers, and workflows. Design, develop, and configure planning models, including dimensions, hierarchies, versions, and currency conversion. Implement live and import data connectivity between SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP S/4HANA. Configure data acquisition, actuals integration, model refresh, and reconciliation processes. Develop driver-based planning logic, including allocations, spreading, seasonality, and price-volume calculations. Build data actions, advanced formulas, input templates, and planning stories to support budgeting and forecasting requirements. jobs.title: Lead DevOps Engineer - L1
jobs.description: Brief Job / Project Description : Build and manage secure CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD across development and production environments. Administer and support OpenShift and ROSA platforms to ensure stable and reliable operations. Automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment, and configuration using IaC and scripting tools. Embed security checks into the delivery pipeline, including code scanning, image scanning, and secrets control. Manage application deployment, release processes, and environment promotion across cloud platforms. Monitor platform health, workloads, logs, and alerts to maintain performance and availability. Troubleshoot pipeline failures, platform issues, and deployment problems with fast resolution. Support containerized applications and maintain platform standards for scalability and resilience. Collaborate with development, security, and infrastructure teams to improve release quality and operational maturity. Maintain operational documentation, technical standards, and continuous improvement of DevSecOps practices. Key Responsibilities: Manage and support GitLab CI/CD pipelines for build, test, and deployment activities. Administer OpenShift and ROSA environments to ensure platform stability and availability. Automate infrastructure, configuration, and deployment processes using IaC and scripting. Apply security controls across pipelines, containers, and cloud operations. Monitor system performance, logs, alerts, and platform health. Troubleshoot incidents, deployment issues, and operational failures. Support container platform operations and application release management. Work with development, cloud, and security teams to improve delivery and reliability. Maintain operational standards, technical documentation, and platform best practices. Drive continuous improvement in DevSecOps and cloud operations Deliverables / Expected Outcomes: Stable and secure GitLab CI/CD pipelines with improved deployment reliability. High availability and smooth operation of OpenShift and ROSA platforms. Faster and more consistent infrastructure and application deployment through automation. Stronger security enforcement across build, release, and runtime environments. Reduced incident impact through effective monitoring and timely issue resolution. Improved platform performance, scalability, and operational stability. Better collaboration across development, cloud, and security teams. Consistent release management and smoother environment promotion. Up-to-date documentation, standards, and operational procedures. Continuous improvement in DevSecOps maturity and cloud operations efficiency. Mandatory Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD pipeline design, administration, and troubleshooting. Strong working knowledge of OpenShift and ROSA platform operations and support. Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar. Strong understanding of cloud operations, platform monitoring, logging, and alerting. Experience in Linux system administration and shell scripting. Knowledge of DevSecOps practices, including vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and secure deployment. Experience with application deployment, release management, and environment promotion. Familiarity with networking, access control, and cloud security concepts. Strong troubleshooting skills across pipelines, containers, cloud platforms, and production environments. Tools / Platforms / Technologies: GitLab for source control and CI/CD pipeline management OpenShift and ROSA for container platform operations Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration Terraform and Ansible for Infrastructure as Code and automation Linux and Bash/Shell scripting for system administration AWS or other cloud platforms for cloud infrastructure operations Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar tools for monitoring and logging SonarQube, SAST/DAST, and container scanning tools for security checks Nexus, JFrog, or similar artifact repositories ServiceNow, Jira, or similar tools for incident and change management Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. Relevant professional certifications in Cloud, Kubernetes, OpenShift, GitLab, DevOps, or Security are preferred. Equivalent hands-on experience in DevSecOps, cloud operations, and platform engineering may be considered in place of formal certifications. Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills: Experience with ROSA architecture, cluster scaling, and platform optimization. Knowledge of GitOps tools and practices such as Argo CD. Familiarity with Red Hat ecosystem tools and enterprise container platforms. Experience with advanced cloud security, IAM policies, and compliance controls. Knowledge of observability tools, dashboard design, and performance tuning. Experience supporting microservices and distributed application environments. Familiarity with Python, Go, or other automation-focused programming languages. Experience with backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning. Understanding of ITSM processes, change management, and release governance. Relevant certifications in AWS, OpenShift, Kubernetes, GitLab, or security are an advantage.

jobs.title: Lead Advanced Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Brief Job / Project Description: Seeking an experienced Data Privacy professional with hands-on expertise in the OneTrust platform to support day-to-day privacy operations, platform administration, configuration, and privacy program enablement. The ideal candidate holds an advanced OneTrust certification and has strong experience configuring and administering OneTrust modules, implementing privacy workflows, and supporting enterprise privacy compliance initiatives. The resource will work closely with Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Security, and IT teams to optimize the platform, improve operational efficiency, and ensure alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities: Perform day-to-day administration and operational support of the OneTrust platform. Configure and maintain OneTrust modules, workflows, assessments, templates, questionnaires, and reporting. Support Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), consent management, and data subject access request (DSAR) processes. Configure privacy workflows, approval processes, notifications, and role-based access controls. Support integrations with enterprise systems and troubleshoot platform issues. Monitor platform health, user access, and operational activities. Collaborate with Privacy, Legal, Compliance, Security, and business stakeholders to onboard new privacy use cases. Support platform enhancements, upgrades, and configuration changes. Develop and maintain privacy documentation, operational procedures, and platform standards. Provide user guidance, training, and knowledge transfer to promote effective platform adoption. Deliverables / Expected Outcomes: Stable and well-managed OneTrust platform operations. Timely resolution of platform incidents and user requests. Configured and optimized privacy workflows aligned with business and regulatory requirements. Up-to-date privacy inventories, assessments, and governance records. Improved operational efficiency and user adoption of the OneTrust platform. Comprehensive documentation of configurations, procedures, and operational runbooks. Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, Law, Data Privacy, or a related discipline. Master's degree is an advantage. Mandatory Technical Skills: Hands-on experience administering and configuring the OneTrust platform. Strong experience with OneTrust Privacy Management modules (e.g., DPIA/PIA, RoPA, Data Subject Rights, Consent & Preference Management, Vendor Risk Management). Knowledge of global privacy regulations such as GDPR, PDPL, and other applicable data protection frameworks. Experience configuring workflows, forms, templates, questionnaires, and reporting. Understanding of APIs, integrations, and enterprise application connectivity. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management skills. Tools / Platforms / Technologies: OneTrust Privacy Management Platform OneTrust Assessment Automation OneTrust Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) OneTrust Consent & Preference Management REST APIs SQL (preferred) Jira Confluence Microsoft Power BI (preferred) Microsoft Office Suite OneTrust, BigID, or similar Data Privacy/Governance tools Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills: Advanced OneTrust Professional Certification(s) Experience implementing or enhancing enterprise privacy programs. Knowledge of data governance concepts and integration with governance platforms such as Collibra. Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP). Familiarity with identity and access management concepts. Proven knowledge of Power BI and experience creating dashboards is preferred. Experience working in Agile environments Certifications (if any): OneTrust Professional Certification (preferred), such as: OneTrust Certified Privacy Professional OneTrust Certified Privacy Management Professional OneTrust Certified Expert (or equivalent advanced platform certification) IAPP certifications (preferred): CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPP/A CIPM CIPT ISO/IEC 27701 or related privacy certifications (nice to have)

The role ensures that all processing of personal data – of millions of customers, 10,000+ employees and DAs , suppliers and partners – complies with Egypt’s Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 (PDPL) and its Executive Regulations, and that privacy is treated as a source of customer trust and a business enabler. The Head of Data Privacy sets the privacy governance framework, advises the CEO, Executive Committee and Board, builds and leads the privacy function. Roles & Responsibilities: Privacy Strategy, Governance & Leadership Define and own the company-wide data privacy strategy, policy framework and multi-year roadmap, approved by the Executive Committee. Establish privacy governance: Privacy Steering Committee, RACI per function, policy hierarchy, and a Privacy Champions network across all departments and sites. Advise the CEO, ExCom and Board on privacy risk, regulatory exposure and the privacy implications of strategic initiatives (new business lines, M&A, market expansion, partnerships). Build, lead and develop the privacy team; set budget, capability plan and success measures for the function. Regulatory Compliance & PDPC Relationship Act as the registered Group DPO and primary point of contact with the PDPC; maintain registrations, licences and permits required under the PDPL for Breadfast as data controller and processor. Lead the company-wide PDPL compliance programme and close gaps within the regulatory grace period of the Executive Regulations. Monitor the PDPL, Executive Regulations, PDPC decisions and adjacent regulations (e.g., Central Bank of Egypt requirements for payments/fintech, consumer protection, e-commerce and cybercrime laws) and translate them into business requirements. Represent Breadfast in PDPC inspections, inquiries and industry forums. Enterprise Data Mapping & Records of Processing Own the enterprise Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) across all functions and systems: customer app and website, CRM, marketing and loyalty, payments, ERP, HRIS/payroll, WMS/TMS, rider apps and telematics, CCTV and biometrics. Maintain data classification, with controls for sensitive personal data ( Biometrics, health/medical records, financial data, national ID data, criminal record certificates) Privacy by Design, Risk & Impact Assessments Embed privacy-by-design and by-default in the product and tech lifecycle; privacy sign-off before launch of new features, systems and data uses. Set the DPIA methodology and ensure DPIAs for high-risk processing: customer profiling and personalization, AI/ML models, marketing analytics, rider GPS tracking, workplace CCTV, biometric attendance, credit/BNPL or payments features. Maintain the enterprise privacy risk register, integrated into Breadfast’s Enterprise Risk Management framework. Customer Trust, Marketing & Data Use Ensure lawful basis, clear notices and consent management for customers across app, web, calls, and marketing channels (SMS, push, email, WhatsApp), including direct marketing consent rules under the PDPL. Govern data sharing with partners, advertisers and analytics providers; set rules for anonymization and pseudonymization of data used for analytics and AI. Own customer-facing privacy policy and cookie/tracking practices. 3.6 Employee & Workforce Privacy Partner with People & Culture on privacy for the full employee lifecycle – recruitment, onboarding, background checks, payroll, social insurance, medical data, pictures, performance and offboarding. Ensure fit-for-purpose privacy notices and training for the front-liners teams, blue-collar and outsourced workforce (clear Arabic, practical formats). Third-Party, Vendor & Cross-Border Data Management Set the third-party privacy risk framework: due diligence, data processing agreements, audits and offboarding for all processors (cloud and SaaS vendors, 3PLs, rider and manpower agencies, payment providers, marketing agencies). Govern cross-border data transfers in line with PDPL conditions and PDPC licensing/approval requirements. Data Subject Rights & Complaints Own the enterprise process for data subject requests (access, correction, erasure, objection, consent withdrawal) for customers, employees and partners, within statutory deadlines. Oversee privacy complaints and escalations, in coordination with Customer Experience, P&C and Legal. Breach Management & Information Security Partnership Own the personal data breach response plan; jointly lead incident response with the CISO/Information Security. Decide on and lead notification to the PDPC and affected data subjects within the legal timeframe (72 hours to the PDPC under the PDPL). Partner with the CISO on technical and organizational security measures, retention schedules and secure disposal across offices, sites and devices. Awareness, Culture & Assurance Design the enterprise privacy training and awareness programme, tailored by audience (ExCom, tech and product, marketing, customer service, operations, frontline workforce). Run a compliance monitoring and assurance plan; support Internal Audit and external audits; report privacy KPIs quarterly to ExCom and the Audit & Risk Committee. Required Education, Knowledge, And Skills: Education Bachelor’s degree in Law, Information Systems, Computer Science or Business Administration. Master’s degree / LLM in technology, data or privacy law is a strong plus. Mandatory Regulatory Requirement (Egypt PDPL) Registered in the PDPC’s DPO Registry, at the highest category/level (Category A / Lead level), given the volume and sensitivity of the personal data Breadfast processes – or able to obtain it before appointment. Passed the PDPC-approved DPO examination required for registration. Keeps registration valid; it lasts two years and must be renewed. Supporting International Certifications (preferred, not a substitute for PDPC registration) IAPP, ISC2, PECB or ISO-accredited IAPP CIPP/E and CIPM; CIPT or FIP a plus. ISO/IEC 27701 or ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor; CISA, CISM or CDPSE advantageous. The PDPC may take relevant certifications into account when assigning a DPO’s registration category. Experience 12+ years in data protection, information security, compliance or technology law, including 5+ years leading a privacy programme or function. Proven track record building an enterprise privacy programme end-to-end (governance, RoPA, DPIAs, DSRs, breach response, vendor management) in a large organisation. Experience in consumer-facing digital businesses – e-commerce, quick-commerce, retail/FMCG, telecom or fintech – with large customer databases and a large frontline workforce. Hands-on experience with Egypt PDPL compliance; strong GDPR experience; GCC privacy laws (Saudi PDPL, UAE PDPL) a plus. Experience presenting to Executive Committees and Boards, and dealing directly with regulators. We are building a highly resilient advertising platform with a very lean, senior internal team, and we intend to keep it that way. To achieve scale without the overhead of a large engineering department, we rely on an AI-first development paradigm and a philosophy borrowed from the best large-scale open-source projects. Our code is not public, but our governance is theirs: asynchronous communication, exhaustive written documentation, explicit rules, and uncompromising quality gates. It is the only way a small team of humans and AI agents ships serious systems without accumulating technical debt. This role owns the part of that platform where money and latency meet: the serving path and the integrations to external ad systems. -The Role You will own, end to end, the connectors and serving logic that turn an ad request into a served, billed impression. This is hands-on, systems-level backend work with a direct revenue impact and a low tolerance for error. 1. Ad Serving & Integrations. Build and own the integrations to external ad servers and demand partners, the serving gateway, and the augmentation and bidding logic that sits between them. You are the person who understands, precisely, how these systems talk to each other and why. 2. Correctness on the Hot Path. The serving path is real-time and handles money. You will hold the line on latency, on monetary correctness, on idempotency, and on the reconciliation between what was decided, what was cleared, and what was billed. A silent error here is a production incident. 3. AI-First Delivery.We expect AI to write the majority of the code; you are the editor, not the typist. You will specify work as explicit, self-sufficient issues, direct agentic tooling (e.g. Claude Code) to implement, and remain the final gatekeeper on every diff, whether it came from an agent or a human. 4. Governance & Documentation. Everything is written down. You will maintain Architecture Decision Records for the integration contracts you own, keep API definitions as the single source of truth, and enforce strict review on your own domain. If it is not documented, it does not exist. The Tech Stack - Language: Rust (backend, asynchronous services). - Interfaces: gRPC and REST service APIs, contract-first. - Data & Messaging:relational databases, event streaming. - Domain:ad serving, retail media, real-time bidding, auctions and reconciliation. - Cloud:Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes. Profile & Requirements We are looking for a highly autonomous, systems-oriented backend engineer who is energised by a lean, high-quality environment and owns their surface completely. This role is not suited to someone who wants tickets handed to them inside a large team. Essential Experience - 5+ years building backend systems in production, with real ownership of availability, latency and correctness under load. - Rust in production or a serious open-source project — or exceptional depth in another compiled systems language (Go, C++) with a demonstrated, immediate willingness to master Rust. - Hands-on experience with asynchronous services, service-to-service APIs, and message streaming . - Ad-tech domain experience (ad servers, DSP/SSP, real-time bidding, retail media) is a strong advantage; the ability to reason about money, auctions and reconciliation is expected. -Core Competencies & Mindset - AI Development Lifecycle: genuine proficiency editing and validating AI-produced code, and turning ambiguous goals into ultra-clear specifications an agent can execute without a meeting. - Uncompromising Quality:a maniacal focus on the non-functional requirements — performance, security, reliability, correctness. You are the last line before production. - Distributed & complex systems: knowledge of, and a taste for, distributed and complex systems is very welcome. Tell us about the ones you have built or operated — what made them hard, and what you took from them. - Written & Asynchronous: exceptional written communication. You operate effectively in a globally distributed, async environment (Paris timezone +/- 3h). - Ownership: you treat the domain you own as yours, documentation included, and you do not wait to be asked.

We describe the problems; we expect you to bring the approach. 2. Stream-First Pipeline.Own the ingestion and processing pipeline. AI-First Delivery & Governance. We expect AI to write most of the code; you are the editor, not the typist. A wrong number that ships is a wrong number the business trusts. - Written & Asynchronous: exceptional written communication; effective in a distributed, async environment (Paris timezone +/- 3h). - Ownership: you own your pipeline and its documentation completely, and you surface problems before they are asked about.

Fortement soutenue par des investisseurs de renommée mondiale tels que BOND et Y Combinator, pionniers d'entreprises telles qu'Airbnb, Stripe, Dropbox, et Doordash, Yassir a réussi à faire de nombreuses levées de fonds équivalentes à presque 200 millions $. Au-delà de la simple prestation de services, notre vision est de créer un marché dynamique visant à satisfaire les besoins de nos utilisateurs tout en insufflant des valeurs sociales fondamentales. Rôle : Nous recherchons un Sales Representative (terrain) motivé et orienté résultats pour rejoindre notre équipe en pleine croissance ! Ta mission principale : acquérir de nouveaux agents , entretenir des relations solides avec les agents existants, et faire croître l’activité sur ton territoire. Missions : Identifier et cibler de manière proactive les commerçants à fort potentiel pour leur proposer de devenir agents Yassir . Présenter le produit agent wallet (portefeuille agent), en mettant en avant ses avantages pour les agents (revenus supplémentaires) et leurs clients (inclusion financière). Négocier et intégrer de nouveaux agents, tout en s’assurant qu’ils comprennent bien les offres et les conditions contractuelles. Entretenir des relations solides avec les agents assignés, assurer une communication fluide et répondre rapidement à leurs préoccupations. Réaliser des visites régulières pour garantir la satisfaction des agents et leur fournir un support continu. Développer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies pour accroître le volume de transactions et les revenus générés par le réseau d’agents. Identifier les opportunités de vente additionnelle des services Yassir auprès des agents existants. Surveiller en permanence le bon fonctionnement du service chez les agents, détecter les blocages éventuels. Aider les agents à résoudre les interruptions de service et s’assurer que leurs portefeuilles électroniques sont toujours approvisionnés (argent digital ou espèces). Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le Team Leader pour résoudre les problèmes de liquidité des agents et garantir la fluidité des opérations. Profil recherché : Minimum 2 ans d’expérience dans la vente, idéalement dans les services financiers , les télécoms , le tabac ou les produits de grande consommation (FMCG) Excellentes compétences en communication , négociation et relations interpersonnelles Capacité à établir des relations de confiance avec les clients Motivation personnelle, esprit de conquête , orienté résultats Bon sens de l’organisation et gestion du temps À l’aise avec les applications mobiles Permis de conduire et véhicule obligatoire (voiture)

jobs.title: Senior Lead Agentic Developer
jobs.description: About Integrant For 34 years, Integrant has designed and delivered advanced, business solutions for U.S. enterprises in biotech, medical devices, manufacturing, finance, and related highly regulated industries. Our teams are experts in traditional web and mobile applications, AI/HPC infrastructure support, data engineering, predictive AI, machine learning, and Agentic solutions. We build long-term partnerships—two-thirds of our customers choosing to partner with us 5+ years—by solving mission-critical problems with rigor, empathy, and measurable outcomes. Role overview Title: Agentic Developer (Enterprise Agentic Systems) Mission: Build production-grade AI agents that run real business processes inside enterprise environments — reliably, securely, observably, and with measurable ROI. This is not a prompt-engineering or demo-building role. The person we hire owns the full lifecycle of an agent: design, implementation, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. They treat an agent as a distributed software system with a probabilistic component, not as a chatbot with tools attached. Stack-agnostic by design. We use Python and TypeScript, and frameworks such as LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, Bedrock Agents, and Copilot Studio appear in our work as examples, not requirements. We hire for the underlying engineering judgment: someone who can pick up any orchestration framework in a week because they understand what every framework is abstracting. Key responsibilities: 1. Agent design & orchestration Design single-agent and multi-agent systems: planner/executor, supervisor/worker, hierarchical, and event-driven patterns, choosing the simplest pattern that meets the requirement. Model agent workflows as explicit state machines or graphs with defined states, transitions, retries, timeouts, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Define tool contracts (schemas, idempotency, error semantics) and implement tool-calling with validation and graceful degradation. Implement memory strategies: short-term context management, long-term memory stores, and session persistence with clear retention rules. 2. Retrieval & knowledge (RAG at scale) Build and tune retrieval pipelines: chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re-ranking, metadata filtering, and query rewriting. Handle enterprise document realities: permissions-aware retrieval, multi-tenant isolation, freshness and sync from source systems. Measure retrieval quality (recall, precision, groundedness) and fix it at the pipeline level, not the prompt level. 3. Evaluation, testing & quality Build eval suites before shipping: golden datasets, task-level success metrics, LLM-as-judge with calibration, regression tests on every change. Write unit and integration tests for tools, state transitions, and guardrails; test the non-LLM 80% like any other software. Run offline and online evals; use A/B or shadow deployments to validate changes against production traffic. 4. Observability & operations Instrument agents end-to-end: traces per run, token/cost accounting, latency per step, tool-call outcomes, and failure classification. Define SLOs for agents (success rate, p95 latency, cost per task) and build dashboards and alerts against them. Operate agents in production: on-call participation, incident analysis, root-cause on model and non-model failures. 5. Security, safety & governance Implement defenses against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and tool misuse; enforce least-privilege for every tool and integration. Apply input/output guardrails, PII handling, content policies, and audit logging that satisfies enterprise compliance. Design human-approval gates for high-impact actions and make agent decisions explainable to auditors and business owners. 6. Enterprise integration Integrate agents with ERP, CRM, ITSM, document management, and identity systems via APIs, event streams, and MCP-style tool servers. Handle authentication and authorization on behalf of users (OAuth, service principals, delegated access) correctly. Build agents that survive real data: inconsistent records, partial failures, rate limits, and legacy interfaces. 7. Delivery & collaboration Translate business processes into agent specifications with clear success criteria and ROI measures. Produce architecture decision records, runbooks, and handover documentation. Mentor engineers transitioning into agentic development; review designs and code for agent-specific pitfalls. Requirements Must-have 8+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 1–2 years shipping LLM-based systems to production users. Strong in Python or TypeScript, working proficiency in the other; comfortable with async programming, API design, and typed data models (e.g., Pydantic/Zod). Has built at least one agent that runs a real multi-step workflow with tool calls in production, and can describe its failure modes and how they were fixed. Hands-on with at least one orchestration framework (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Bedrock Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar) and able to explain what it abstracts and when to drop to raw API calls. Practical RAG experience: vector and hybrid search, chunking strategy, re-ranking, and retrieval evaluation. Experience writing evals for LLM systems and treating prompt changes as code changes with regression coverage. Working knowledge of observability tooling (OpenTelemetry-style tracing, LLM tracing platforms such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or equivalent). Understanding of LLM security threats (prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency) and standard mitigations. Experience integrating with enterprise systems through REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, or message queues, including auth flows (OAuth 2.0, service accounts). Experience with workflow engines (Temporal, or Durable Functions, or Step Functions) for long-running agent processes. Model Context Protocol (MCP) server or client implementation. Nice-to-have Cloud deployment experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP) with containers and CI/CD Fine-tuning or distillation experience, or structured-output and function-calling optimization at scale. You will play a crucial role in shaping the product's growth through influencing the architecture, driving code quality, developing software, growing the team and actively contributing to the codebase. We are looking for someone passionate about taking on the deep tech challenge of building innovative structural optimization products. Structural optimization is not easy—it is scarcely applied in industry due to its complex intersection of civil/structural engineering and software engineering. We prioritize results over processes, and your performance will be evaluated based on the quality and impact of your contributions, as well as your influence on team collaboration and delivery. We are creating a scalable solution to a global problem: the construction industry is significantly inefficient, using more concrete and steel than is structurally needed. Our research team extracted 400 peer-reviewed academic papers, representing about 1,900 structures with an average structural inefficiency of 21%. In this role, your software skills will optimize both performance and building structures—helping build more sustainable cities and managing a young team excited to create impact. You will be one of the first software engineers. We currently have 3 software engineers and 12 CSEs (computational structural engineers) who are actively contributing to our code. You will work closely with our CTO, who has relocated from Silicon Valley (SF) to Dubai (and Cairo). He brings experience working with large data sets at Pinterest and Insuretech—and is now focusing on AI-powered structural engineering.

The role combines Generative AI, AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent automation, and applied machine learning to solve real logistics and operational problems. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps/Platform, Data, Security, and Operations teams to take AI solutions from business requirements and prototypes into reliable production services. AI Agents & Intelligent Automation • Design and develop AI agents for logistics workflows such as dispatch assistance, customer support, shipment exception handling, operations support, and internal productivity. • Build reliable agentic workflows that combine LLM reasoning, deterministic business rules, APIs, enterprise data, and external systems. • Implement appropriate state management, memory, tool usage, workflow orchestration, and human approval steps. • Define boundaries between AI-driven decisions and deterministic application logic. • Design human-in-the-loop workflows where AI-generated decisions or actions require review or approval. • Ensure AI agents operate within clearly defined permissions and business boundaries. AI Evaluation & Quality Engineering • Design evaluation frameworks and test datasets for measuring AI system performance. • Evaluate solutions across dimensions including retrieval quality, groundedness, hallucination rate, task completion and success rate, response quality, accuracy, latency, reliability, token consumption, and cost. • Establish regression testing for prompts, retrieval pipelines, models, tools, and agent workflows. • Develop golden datasets and benchmark scenarios for critical Madar AI use cases. • Apply human evaluation, automated evaluation, and LLM-as-a-judge approaches where appropriate. • Continuously measure production AI performance and identify opportunities for improvement. AI Security, Governance & Responsible AI • Apply secure AI engineering practices to protect Madar's customers, systems, and business data. • Implement controls against prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, sensitive information leakage, unauthorized data access, excessive agent permissions, unsafe tool execution, and cross-user or cross-tenant data exposure. • Design secure authorization models for RAG applications and AI agents. • Ensure AI applications respect existing application-level access controls and data boundaries. • Apply secure secrets management and authentication when integrating AI services with internal and external systems. • Support auditability by implementing appropriate logging, tracing, and monitoring of AI interactions and actions. • Work with Security and Platform teams to establish practical AI governance and security standards Engineering AI Adoption • Drive practical adoption of Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools across Madar engineering teams. • Develop reusable AI skills, subagents, prompt templates, engineering instructions, and development workflows. • Help engineers use AI effectively for coding, unit and integration testing, code reviews, debugging, documentation, refactoring, application migrations, and infrastructure and automation tasks. • Establish practical standards and engineering playbooks for AI-assisted software development. • Identify engineering workflows where AI can improve development velocity, quality, or operational efficiency. • Support engineering teams in using AI responsibly without compromising software quality, security, or maintainability. AI Platform, Production & MLOps • Design AI services for scalability, availability, maintainability, and production readiness. • Build APIs and reusable services that allow AI functionality to be consumed by different Madar applications. • Work with DevOps and Platform teams to establish CI/CD practices for AI applications. • Implement observability for AI services, including application tracing, model and prompt performance, request latency, token usage, model cost, error rates, and retrieval performance. • Monitor production AI applications and continuously identify operational or quality issues. • Optimize solutions based on quality, latency, throughput, infrastructure cost, and model/API cost. • Support versioning and controlled rollout of models, prompts, embeddings, retrieval strategies, and agent workflows. jobs.title: Investigation Specialist, Trust & Safety
jobs.description: In this role, you’ll be the person who keeps our delivery ecosystem honest, safe, and running smoothly. You’ll investigate issues that could impact drivers or customers, spot patterns before they turn into real problems, and bring clarity to situations that often feel messy or ambiguous. What sets this position apart is the blend of analytical thinking and people-centered judgement: you’ll dive into facts, speak with the right stakeholders, and guide decisions that affect the overall health of our delivery partners. If you enjoy solving problems that matter, protecting people, and building mechanisms that make operations better every day, this role puts you right at the heart of it. Key job responsibilities • Look into reported incidents and uncover what really happened by gathering facts, interviewing stakeholders, and analyzing available data. • Drive fair and consistent decision-making when issues arise, ensuring both drivers’ rights and business expectations are respected. • Identify early warning signs, behavioral trends, recurring violations, or gaps in compliance—and take action before problems escalate. • Work closely with operational teams and DSP to explain findings, agree on corrective steps, and monitor follow-through. • Help build simple mechanisms and routines that prevent repeated issues and make the overall ecosystem safer and more reliable. • Prepare clear summaries and recommendations that help leaders act quickly and confidently. • Support escalations when needed, especially in situations that could affect safety, customer experience, or business continuity. • Maintain balanced judgement in sensitive or time-pressured cases, ensuring fairness and consistency at all times. A day in the life Your day starts with reviewing any new incidents that came in overnight. You look at the facts, reach out to the right people, and assess whether anything needs urgent attention. You might spend part of the morning speaking Stakeholders to understand what went wrong in a recent situation, or walking them through the actions they need to take next. Later in the day, you dig into patterns, maybe a location has repeated complaints, or a partner shows early signs of non-compliance. You connect with field teams, ask direct questions, and help them see what needs to change. Some days are calm; others involve navigating sensitive topics or guiding teams through decisions. Throughout, your goal stays the same: protect people, protect the customer experience, and keep the delivery network healthy, fair, and functioning smoothly. About the team The Network Health (NH) and Trust & Safety (T&S) teams work together to protect Amazon’s Last Mile operations by driving compliance, partner accountability, and safety across the AMET region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Turkey). Network Health owns the end-to-end compliance and enforcement lifecycle for Delivery Service Partners (DSPs) — from risk identification and MEP (Monitoring & Enforcement Plan) management to exit governance and performance reviews. The team ensures that all DSPs operate safely, ethically, and in alignment with Amazon’s Supply Chain Standards and local labor regulations. Trust & Safety complements this work by focusing on driver-level safety, identity verification, and incident resolution programs such as Sentinel, DWEL, and DAF, ensuring that both DSPs and drivers uphold Amazon’s zero-tolerance standards on compliance and worker welfare. - 1+ years of customer service experience - Speak, write, and read fluently in English - Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications - Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays - Experience in payments or e-commerce - Experience working with Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook, etc.)

jobs.description: The Senior AI Engineer is a senior individual contributor with deep expertise in a specific domain of AI/ML, responsible for tackling the most complex technical challenges, driving architectural decisions for critical AI components, and setting technical standards. This role requires a blend of advanced research understanding and robust engineering skills to bring cutting-edge AI innovations into production.The difference you will makeAct as a subject matter expert in one or more specialized AI/ML domains (e.g., Generative AI, Explainable AI, Large Language Models, Reinforcement Learning, Real-time Anomaly Detection). Lead the design and implementation of highly scalable, fault-tolerant, and high-performance AI systems and infrastructure. Evaluate and integrate new AI/ML research, algorithms, and technologies into product development. Drive continuous improvement in MLOps, model monitoring, and model governance frameworks. Provide expert technical guidance and mentorship to other AI Engineer 1s and Associates. Conduct complex performance tuning, optimization, and debugging of AI/ML models and pipelines. Participate in strategic planning for AI initiatives, identifying opportunities for technological advancement. Influence technical direction and architecture discussions within the AI/ML team and across engineering. Lead code reviews for critical components, ensuring architectural integrity, performance, and maintainability. Education: Bachelor’s degree or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related quantitative field. Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in AI/ML engineering, with a proven track record of designing and deploying complex AI systems into production. Demonstrated deep expertise in a specific AI sub-field.Technical Skills: Expert-level proficiency in Python and advanced ML/DL frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX). Extensive experience with cloud-native AI/ML services and distributed computing frameworks (e.g., Spark, Ray). Deep understanding and hands-on experience with MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model serving, and monitoring in production environments. Strong architectural design skills for complex data pipelines and scalable AI inference systems. Proficiency in system design, distributed systems, and performance optimization. Ability to critically evaluate and apply academic research to real-world problems.Soft Skills: Strong ownership and accountability for assigned work. Clear and professional verbal and written communication. Effective time management and task prioritization. o Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently, collaborate effectively and mentor junior team members. Ability to actively listen to customers and accurately understand their needs, expectations, and challenges. Adaptability and learning agility in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality. jobs.description: Head of Marketing | FabMinds Home WandDo Features Pre-Order Pricing Careers Join Our Team About Who We Are Our Values Inside FabMinds Contact Us Menu Home WandDo Features Pre-Order Pricing Careers Join Our Team About Who We Are Our Values Inside FabMinds Contact Us WandDo Shop - Careers a product by Fab-Minds Inc Head of Marketing Marketing, Cairo, Egypt WandDo is a Cairo-based e-commerce brand built on a single idea: what you own should be made for you. Not chosen from a catalog, made for you, your name, your moment. We produce personalized products on demand from our own network of industrial 3D printers: desk accessories, home décor, lighting, and corporate gifts today. Personalized furniture, IoT gadgets, and categories that don't exist yet tomorrow. The technology isn't the product. It's the platform for an idea. WandDo is powered by FabMinds, a company building an AI-powered manufacturing platform that WandDo directly powers and proves. Every order, every preference, every demand signal feeds into it. This isn't just a consumer brand: it's the proof of concept for a new category of manufacturing. This is a senior marketing leadership role with two simultaneous mandates. Scale our strong and growing paid-media-driven revenue, doubling and tripling it with better ROAS. And build the kind of brand that earns its own gravity, where people seek WandDo out, share it, and buy from it because they believe in it, not because an ad found them. This role reports to the VP of Marketing & Business Development. This is a performance-based role. You will own WandDo's monthly revenue and growth number, judged on results. We are looking for someone who has already delivered at this scale: a proven track record of leading marketing for a recognized local brand, with real personal accountability for a revenue number. Gulf experience (KSA, UAE) is a strong plus. Roles & Responsibilities Performance Marketing Oversight: Own the results of the paid media function, not by running it personally, but by setting the strategy that drives it. Define the creative direction, offer logic, and ROAS standards the team executes against. Build a culture of rapid, hypothesis-driven testing across Meta, TikTok, and other active channels. Challenge what isn't working. Double down on what is. Brand Story & Identity: Define the single narrative that makes WandDo impossible to confuse with any other brand. Not a tagline: the founding truth of why this brand exists, what it stands against (mass production, generic ownership), and what it stands for. Every category WandDo enters, today's accessories, tomorrow's furniture, the IoT gadgets after that, must feel like the natural next expression of one idea. Consumer Research & Product Ideation: Be the company's most reliable source of what to build next. Go beyond analytics: talk to customers, track what people complain about, study what they customize themselves, watch adjacent categories. Bring concrete product ideas to the team with a clear case for why the demand is real and the timing is right. Earned Media & Organic Growth Engine: Build the systems that make customers share, creators post, and press write, without being paid to. The personalization reveal moment, the unboxing experience, the UGC strategy, PR hooks, and the community layer that turns buyers into advocates. Paid ads run the engine today. This responsibility is about building the flywheel that makes it lighter over time. Customer Psychology & Positioning: Own a deep understanding of why each buyer segment actually buys: self-purchase (identity), gifting (what it says about the giver), corporate (status, reciprocity). Ensure this informs every creative decision and message across both paid and organic channels. Content & Creative Direction: Write or directly brief every ad hook, script, and piece of on-site copy. Direct the creative team's output around a stated psychological or brand angle, not just aesthetics. Own on-site conversion rate, including the live personalization preview, the most direct expression of the brand's core promise. Offer & Pricing Strategy: Own bundling, pricing logic, and occasion-based offers (Eid, Mother's Day, back-to-school). Every offer must be rooted in the customer's psychology and the brand's story, not reactive discounting that trains buyers to wait for sales and quietly erodes what the brand stands for. Retention & Community: Own the post-purchase relationship through WhatsApp-led CRM. Build the system that treats every customer as a potential advocate, a repeat buyer at the next life moment, and a referral source. Team Leadership: Directly manage: media buyer, performance marketer, content creator(s), and a CRM/retention specialist. Set direction, develop capability, and hold the team accountable for output, not hours. Requirements 7+ years in marketing with a proven track record of personally owning a revenue number for a recognized local brand: real accountability for the result, not just the activity. Deep understanding of paid media (Meta, TikTok, performance fundamentals) sufficient to set strategy and know when numbers are being gamed. Proven experience building a brand with genuine organic pull: a following, a community, or earned media that didn't need budget to sustain. Gulf market experience (KSA, UAE) is a strong plus. Proven background in D2C or e-commerce in Egypt or a similar market, where cash-on-delivery is the norm and WhatsApp is where most customer questions and confirmations actually happen. Fluency in direct-response storytelling and consumer psychology: understanding not just which message converts, but why. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a small, high-output team (3 to 5 people) directly. Working fluency in Arabic and English, written and spoken. Desired Candidate Qualities Can run a paid media function and build a brand simultaneously, and understands they are not in conflict: just different time horizons. Explains why a campaign won in terms of what the customer actually wanted, not just which version had a better CTR. Sees WandDo not as a gifting brand or a 3D printing company, but as the brand that owns personalization, and can articulate what that means for every category it enters next. Doesn't wait for the product team to hand them something to sell. Comes back with a customer insight, a market gap, and a reason the timing is right. Has killed a short-term tactic: not because it didn't convert, but because it was quietly damaging something more valuable. Comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage company: real constraints, decisions made in days not quarters. What We Offer Full ownership of a live, fast-growing consumer brand at a stage where the story is still being written: this role shapes what WandDo becomes. A reporting line to the VP of Marketing & Business Development, with direct access to the CEO and genuine influence over the company's direction. Compensation built around performance: competitive base salary plus a significant bonus tied directly to monthly revenue and growth targets. A clear growth path toward VP of Marketing or an expanded regional leadership position as WandDo scales into new markets and categories. Visibility into a broader AI-powered manufacturing platform that WandDo's customer data feeds directly into: this role matters well beyond the brand itself. Opportunities for growth through a wide spectrum of challenging assignments. Respectful workplace with a strong and diverse culture that encourages innovation and endorses equality. Continuous development through interaction and mentoring from skilled managers and peers, as well as formal training. Endorsement of employees' health and wellness as well as work-life balance. Customer Support Specialist Cairo, Egypt Description FabMinds is seeking a dedicated Customer Support & Social Media Moderator to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and responding to customer inquiries, comments, and messages on our social media platforms. Additionally, this role involves handling phone calls to confirm orders, resolving issues related to order cancellations, and updating our CRM system. The candidate should have excellent communication skills, be highly organized, and demonstrate a passion for delivering exceptional customer service. Roles & Responsibilities Social Media Management: Monitor and respond to comments, messages, and inquiries across all social media platforms promptly and professionally. Escalate complex issues to the relevant departments while ensuring a seamless customer experience. Engage with the online community to foster positive customer relationships and build brand loyalty. Customer Support: Handle incoming and outgoing calls with customers to confirm orders, answer queries, and resolve any order-related issues Communicate clearly and effectively with customers to address concerns regarding cancellations, refunds, and other support-related matters. CRM Management: Update and manage customer data in the CRM system, ensuring all interactions, order confirmations, and cancellations are properly recorded. General Administration: Assist in reporting customer feedback to improve products, services, and overall customer experience. Proficiency in using customer support software and CRM tools. Desired Candidate Qualities: Empathetic and patient with a customer-first mindset. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to engage with a diverse range of customers. Tech-savvy and adaptable to new systems or platforms. Proactive, with the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously. A positive attitude, with a focus on providing excellent customer service. What We Offer Opportunities for growth through a wide spectrum of challenging assignments. Competitive compensation package and benefits in line with qualifications and experience. Respectful workplace with strong and diverse culture that encourages innovation and endorse equality.
